description: Source code for the Kint debugging tool, providing variable dump and stack trace functionalities with multiple output modes and configuration options.

classes.name: Kint
classes.description: Main class providing configuration, output, and trace functionalities for the Kint debugging tool.

methods.name: enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables Kint, or retrieves the current mode.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Outputs a stack trace as a variable dump.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs detailed information about variables, supporting various output modes and modifiers.

methods.name: shortenPath
methods.description: Generates a shorter, more relevant path display for files.

methods.name: getIdeLink
methods.description: Creates an IDE link for a given file and line number based on configuration.

methods.name: _showSource
methods.description: Displays source code lines around a specific line in a file for context.

methods.name: _getCalleeInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the function or method call that invoked the dump, including parameters and modifiers.

methods.name: _removeAllButCode
methods.description: Removes comments and non-code tokens from PHP source for parsing.

methods.name: _stepIsInternal
methods.description: Determines whether a trace step is part of Kint or its wrappers.

methods.name: _parseTrace
methods.description: Parses and formats a debug backtrace for display.
